observations: Photo 0 shows a white Nikon Coolpix S31 camera held in hand, with a label on the front stating 'Easy to use', 'Waterproof 5m/16.4ft', 'Wide 3x Zoom', 'Shockproof 1.2m/3.9ft'.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the front lens area, showing 'WATERPROOF 5.0m/16.4ft' and 'SHOCKPROOF 1.2m/3.9ft' printed on the body.
Photo 2 shows the rear of the camera with a small screen, a control dial, and buttons. The screen is off and appears to have smudges or fingerprints.
The camera has a silver lens barrel with 'NIKKOR 3X OPTICAL' engraved on it.
The camera body appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or major damage.
The plastic bag in the background has 'McSteve' branding, suggesting the item may be new or recently unpacked.
